role: Post-outcome methodological extension only; preserve all existing empirical decisions.

geometry.eligibility: Reuse the frozen >=40 classifiable-photo species frame. Existing classifiability is a measurement-derived selection mask, not an outcome-independent random missingness mechanism. No biological colour values enter this benchmark.
geometry.missingness_comparison: Same species identities, same 20-photo draw size; compare retained pools with complete-coordinate pools. This isolates a support/sampling contrast conditional on selected species, not a causal missingness effect. No missing real colour is imputed.

splits.species_assignment: Sort eligible species by SHA256('2026090702|species_split|' + species); first floor(369/2)=184 are training-only and the remaining 185 evaluation-only in every fold/world.
splits.geographic_folds: Four longitude sectors floor(((longitude+180) mod 360)/90), numbered 0,1,2,3. Evaluation photos are restricted to the selected sector.
splits.buffer_reference: All complete-coordinate photos of the 369 fixed eligible species in the held-out longitude sector. Exclude training photos outside the sector whose nearest reference point is <500 km great-circle distance.
splits.species_only_comparator: Use all-region training pools of the exact same training species; keep evaluation species and target-sector pools unchanged. This is not a random-photo holdout and not a within-species fit.
splits.capacity: Training species require >=20 retained photos outside the sector and buffer; evaluation species require >=20 retained photos inside the sector. Need >=20 eligible species in each role in all four folds; otherwise stop not_evaluable without relaxing thresholds.
splits.sampling: Each world resamples 20 training and 20 evaluation species per fold without replacement from metadata-eligible role pools, then 20 distinct photos per species. Geometry schedules are shared across signal scenarios at the same stage/replicate. Species selections and random photo priorities are paired across the two frames and two modes.
splits.fold_aggregation: Equal mean of all four fold transfer scores is the test statistic. All four folds are retained; no best-fold selection or treatment of folds/species pairs as independent simulation replicates.

synthetic_worlds.representation: Reuse parent three-dimensional sqrt(3)*spherical Cartesian coordinates and its fixed two-dimensional fourth-harmonic synthetic environment. No real climate or learned coordinate transform.
synthetic_worlds.model: Parent colour-conditioned Gaussian/QDA, equal priors, 20% isotropic covariance shrinkage, ridge 1e-8. ARI is label-swap invariant. Invalid colour groups (<4 photos per class) and constant predictions contribute zero in the fixed denominator.
synthetic_worlds.signal: Reuse amplitude*sign*tanh(projection/0.5)+N(0,1)>0. Species-specific directions are independent; round(369*shared_fraction) species selected by a fresh random permutation share one common direction in positive worlds; others retain independent same-domain directions. Sign is species-specific and irrelevant to ARI.
synthetic_worlds.dependency: For a global synthetic world, draw species response directions and one noise value per original photo once. Reuse them wherever that species/photo occurs across all folds, frames and modes. No real-photo replication is called a new biological sample.

calibration.rule: For each frame/mode and representation, maximum empirical 97.5th percentile (method=higher) over all ten calibration nuisance arms, INCLUDING all three nuisance amplitudes. Use one threshold across positive sharing fractions; no conditioning on the unknown true amplitude.
calibration.comparison: Strictly greater than threshold; retain geography_only, environment_only, both, neither and any-positive counts.
calibration.uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals for 250 independent evaluation-world draws conditional on the fixed support and estimated thresholds. Calibration-threshold uncertainty and generality beyond the finite nuisance family are not certified.
calibration.between_designs: Four prespecified design diagnostics, not four confirmatory biological discoveries or a winner search. No joint type-I guarantee across all designs is asserted.

outputs: all calibration and evaluation scores including per-fold contributions
all four-way decisions and Wilson intervals
unit tests and independent score agreement
forbidden: changing empirical G1/H1-H6 or environmental support decisions
changing seeds or thresholds after outcomes
claiming real environmental commonness or causation
claim_ceiling: Recoverability of a fixed Gaussian transfer statistic under synthetic responses on actual coordinate support and the fixed measurement mask, with disjoint species and buffered spatial holdout. Not real-climate inference, unbiased global-plant sampling, empirical sharing prevalence, causal missingness effects, or proof of geographic/environmental causal separation.
